recipes.group: vibranium_allthemodium / 3 Electrical batch alloy smelting
recipes.comment: Whole-batch alloy formation: 21composition-specific bound dust ->1actual finished alloy ingot +1800mB molten slag. M=21, earlier-loss X=0 in this version, final slag units=M-X-1=20. No invented earlier loss stages or useful byproduct recovery. Strict powder components and full repeated ingredient count prevent partial1dust->1ingot conversion. Three graphite electrodes, Fireproof Vat, superheated/heat-level4, minimum27blocks and24000eligible processing ticks make the alloy-forming operation the costly final stage. Native TFMG electrical load/work-rate and heating apply; the former Polarizer powerRequired values do not transfer and no fixed FE/J or conserved electrical cost is claimed. Finite liquid-helium quench produces hot helium using the existing pack10:1volume convention; fluid accounting is separate from solid M-X units. Slag uses90mB per conceptual solid unit. Shadow Steel/binder production remains upstream. No unrelated ingot carrier, custom item or gameplay export.

recipes.group: Shared precursor workshop / One endgame crystal binder
recipes.comment: One canonical shared endgame Crystal Binder recipe, replacing three per-alloy variants. Preserve the original four mineral constituents; Atomic/Radiance supply the requested expensive binding phase, zirconium/molybdenum the active interface/refractory filler, boron arsenide thermal filler and platinum the stable metallic joining phase. Acid/fluorite and finite helium support preparation, with spent hot helium output. Fictional pack composite chemistry; no real stoichiometry claim. Two units per batch; the three alloy mixers consume2/4/6units. Quantum fluid and Shadow Steel addition stay out of the shared binder so its first batch cannot require the highest alloy branch. The shared preparation marker prevents ordinary shortcut stock satisfying the late mixer requirement; other generic binder consumers still use the same actual item. Existing original Personal/Material Processing references untouched. No gameplay export.

recipes.group: Shared precursor workshop / Hot-pressed silicon carbide preforms
recipes.comment: Industrial Iron pressure forming turns ceramic powder and prepared binder into one solid preform. An ingot-shaped ceramic stock is an existing item, not another renamed powder. Existing pack items only; no gameplay export. Shared precursors are made once for all three alloy paths. User October23 single-ingot correction: one main ingot-equivalent output per operation. Existing full input bill, time, energy, tools, origin predicate and byproducts remain unchanged; the yield loss is deliberate. This does not claim stoichiometric material conservation.

recipes.group: Shared precursor workshop / Nitride powder synthesis
recipes.comment: Pressure-assisted nitride synthesis: two boron dust, existing NuclearCraft nitrogen fluid and a finite reducing hydrogen feed become two boron-nitride powder units. The PRC is not restricted to Mekanism fluids. Hydrogen protects/reduces the reaction charge; no new gas or material ID. Duration4800ticks,32000additional Mekanism J/t (153.6million extraJ plus native base); no fictitious numerical pressure sensor. Existing nitride crystal pressing remains downstream. Proposed authoring only; no gameplay export.

recipes.group: Shared precursor workshop / Refractory zirconium-molybdenum stock
recipes.comment: Cross-mod molten-metal PRC reaction: zirconium powder infiltrates1500mB NuclearCraft molten molybdenum, representing15ingots under the100mB unit policy. HCl provides finite oxide-conditioning chemistry. One usable Zr-Mo ingot comes from the retained1:15 metal input batch; excess material is deliberately unrecovered. Feed HCl through the existing Chemical Infuser/reference recovery route, not a duplicate chemical-mixing card.7200ticks at64000additional Mekanism J/t gives460.8million extraJ plus native base. This is authored pack reactive consolidation, not literal measured alloy chemistry. No new fluid or numeric pressure parameter; no gameplay export. User October23 single-ingot correction: one main ingot-equivalent output per operation. Existing full input bill, time, energy, tools, origin predicate and byproducts remain unchanged; the yield loss is deliberate. This does not claim stoichiometric material conservation.

recipes.group: Shared precursor workshop / Carburized tungsten reinforcement
recipes.comment: Hydrocarbon carburization in the Chemical Injection Chamber turns a tungsten ingot into existing tungsten carbide. The finite1000-unit ethene feed supplies reactive carbon; ethene comes from the existing Mekanism PRC chemical chain. Chemical consumption is once per operation, not every tick. Native configured Injection Chamber energy and cycle apply; no invented per-recipe FE/time fields. Real material change, not dust-to-identical-dust. No gameplay export.

recipes.group: Binder reagents / two branches converge on existing Crystal Binder / Manganese carbonation
recipes.comment: Manganese, a real carbon-dioxide fluid feed and oxygen form manganese carbonate (Rhodochrosite), an actual mineral ingredient of the liked Crystal Binder. One new chemical compound, not identical dust with another label. Carbonation uses the existing NuclearCraft CO2 identity; direct capture/normalization of TFMG flowing heater exhaust is not qualified here.2400ticks at16000additional MekanismJ/t gives38.4million extraJ plus configured base. Volumes are authored game doses, not measured molar stoichiometry. Natural mineral and legitimate chemical byproduct acquisition are not removed. Existing pack identities only; proposed authoring, no gameplay export.

recipes.group: Binder reagents / two branches converge on existing Crystal Binder / Sulfate formation and hydrogen recovery
recipes.comment: Calcium +SO3 +water ->calcium sulfate +hydrogen is the reaction basis. Feed SO3 from the existing Chemical Infuser oxygen/sulfur-dioxide chain; do not add an unchanged duplicate Infuser card. Recover hydrogen into the existing chemical network. Calcium Sulfate feeds the liked Crystal Binder recipe, which remains unchanged.1200ticks at8000additional MekanismJ/t gives9.6million extraJ plus native base. A finite reagent-consuming reaction, not a self-sustaining free gas loop. Existing pack identities only; proposed authoring, no gameplay export.

recipes.group: Thermal ceramics / boron arsenide / Reactive arsenide synthesis
recipes.comment: Use molten arsenic from another mod with boron powder in the PRC under a finite reducing-hydrogen feed.100mB is one nominal ingot under the current unit policy; one boron plus one arsenic input unit produce two compound-stock units. This is pack material accounting, not a real molar mass claim.4800ticks at64000additional MekanismJ/t adds307.2millionJ plus base. Powder then grows into an existing thermal ceramic crystal. No invented arsenide gas/slurry. Existing pack identities only; proposed authoring, no gameplay export.

recipes.group: Thermal ceramics / boron arsenide / High-pressure thermal crystals
recipes.comment: Specialized dust-to-gem pressing follows the latest Pressurizer role. One arsenide powder becomes one boron-arsenide crystal at64000FE/t for2400ticks (153.6millionFE). This feeds the existing protected thermoconducting-alloy Vat reference; that reference and its parked casting endpoint are not rewritten or requeued. Staged dust-only policy explicitly admits this new pair; diamonds remain excluded. Existing pack identities only; proposed authoring, no gameplay export.
